title: Immediately
subtitle: 立即，究竟是怎樣的「立即」？
description: 立即，究竟是怎樣的「立即」？

words.note: 表示某事沒有等待便立即發生或執行。自然、常見，語氣比普通 immediately 稍有命令感時也很常見。
words.example: Please call me at once if the alarm goes off.
words.exampleZh: 如果警報響起，請立刻致電給我。

exercises.original: If you smell gas, leave the building immediately.

options.explanation: 緊急指示中表示不要等待。

exercises.original: The doctor asked to see the patient immediately.

words.note: 非常自然、口語，表示現在就做，不要等。
words.example: I'll send you the file right away.

exercises.original: I'll answer your email immediately.

options.explanation: 日常口語中很自然地表示馬上。

exercises.original: We can fix the problem immediately if you restart the system.

options.explanation: 也可表示迅速處理，但較正式。

words.note: 和 right away 非常接近，表示毫不拖延地做某事。
words.example: We knew straight away that something was wrong.
words.exampleZh: 我們立刻知道出了問題。

exercises.original: I knew immediately that I had sent the message to the wrong person.

options.explanation: 很自然地表示立刻察覺。

exercises.original: Tell me immediately if anything changes.

options.explanation: 表示一有變化就馬上通知。

words.note: 強調事情幾乎在同一瞬間發生，比一般 immediately 更有「瞬時」感。
words.example: The screen went black instantly when the power failed.

exercises.original: The lights went out immediately when the power failed.

options.explanation: 及時，但不如 instantly 強調瞬時。

exercises.original: The medicine relieved the pain almost immediately.

options.explanation: 強調效果幾乎瞬間出現。

words.note: 表示某事及時、沒有不必要延誤地完成。比 instantly 稍弱，但更正式、更常見於工作語境。
words.example: The company responded promptly to the complaint.

exercises.original: The support team responded immediately to the complaint.

options.explanation: 工作語境中表示沒有不必要延誤地回應。

exercises.original: Please report any safety issue immediately.

options.explanation: 表示及時處理，很適合正式工作要求。

words.note: 明確表示不能拖延，應立刻處理。
words.example: Any fault in the system must be reported without delay.
words.exampleZh: 系統任何故障都必須立即報告。

exercises.original: Any defect must be reported immediately.

options.explanation: 正式規則中表示不能拖延。

exercises.original: The injured worker should receive medical attention immediately.

options.explanation: 只表示及時趕上，不等於立即。

words.note: 非常正式、法律或行政語氣，表示應立即執行。
words.example: The tenant was instructed to leave the premises forthwith.
words.exampleZh: 租戶被要求立即離開該處。

exercises.original: The employee was ordered to return the confidential documents immediately.

options.explanation: 正式命令語氣中表示立即執行。

exercises.original: The notice requires the unauthorized material to be removed immediately.

options.explanation: 法律／行政通知中非常合適。

words.note: 在部分英式英語中，directly 可表示很快、立即，尤其是較傳統或正式用法。
words.example: I'll speak to the manager directly.

exercises.original: I'll come and see you immediately after lunch.

options.explanation: 在英式英語中可表示「緊接著、馬上」。

exercises.original: I'll deal with the matter immediately.

options.explanation: 在部分英式語境可表示馬上處理。

words.note: 表示事情就在當時當地立即發生或決定。
words.example: She was offered the job on the spot.
words.exampleZh: 她當場就獲得了這份工作。

exercises.original: The manager offered her the job immediately after the interview.

options.explanation: 表示就在當時當地立即作出決定。

exercises.original: The driver paid the fine immediately at the roadside.

options.explanation: 強調就在現場立即支付。

words.note: 強調某事就在那一刻、那個地方立即發生，語氣比 on the spot 更敘事化。
words.example: He decided then and there to resign.

exercises.original: She decided immediately that she would accept the offer.

options.explanation: 表示就在那一刻立即作決定。

exercises.original: He promised immediately that he would never repeat the mistake.

options.explanation: 當時當地立即作出承諾。

words.note: 語氣強烈，常用於命令，表示就是現在，一秒也不要等。

exercises.original: Come back here immediately!
Stop what you're doing immediately.

words.note: 與 this instant 類似，但稍口語，常表示現在就做。
words.example: I want that report on my desk this minute.
words.exampleZh: 我要那份報告現在就放在我的桌上。

exercises.original: I want you to apologize immediately.

options.explanation: 口語強命令，表示現在就做。

exercises.original: Bring me the keys immediately.

words.note: 表示某件事在另一件事之後立刻發生。
words.example: The alarm sounded, and the building was evacuated immediately afterward.
words.exampleZh: 警報響起後，大樓隨即進行疏散。

exercises.original: The meeting ended, and immediately the participants left the room.

options.explanation: 強調前一件事結束後緊接著發生。

exercises.original: The alarm sounded, and the building was evacuated immediately after that.

words.note: 表示規則、決定、職位變動等從現在開始立即生效。
words.example: The new policy applies with immediate effect.

exercises.original: The new rule applies immediately from today.

options.explanation: 正式公告中表示由現在開始生效。

exercises.original: His resignation takes effect immediately.

options.explanation: 很正式地表示辭職即時生效。

falseSynonyms.zh: soon 表示不久之後；immediately 表示沒有等待。 前者可能幾分鐘、幾小時後；後者強調現在就回覆。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I'll reply soon. I'll reply immediately.

falseSynonyms.zh: quickly 描述動作速度；immediately 描述開始時間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He left immediately but walked slowly. She started later but worked quickly.

falseSynonyms.zh: suddenly 表示出乎意料、突然發生；immediately 表示沒有延遲。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The lights suddenly went out. We immediately turned on the emergency lamps.

falseSynonyms.zh: urgently 表示事情很重要、需要優先處理；immediately 表示時間上沒有延遲。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The matter needs urgent attention. Please respond immediately.

falseSynonyms.zh: eventually 表示經過一段時間後終於發生；immediately 表示立刻發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He eventually agreed after several hours. She agreed immediately.

falseSynonyms.zh: currently 表示現在的狀態；immediately 表示某個行動何時發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The office is currently closed. Please leave immediately.

falseSynonyms.zh: directly 很常表示「直接地」，不是「立即」。 第二句在部分英式英語可表示「我馬上去談」，但也可能被理解為「直接和經理談」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Speak directly to the manager. I'll speak to the manager directly.

falseSynonyms.zh: instant 多作名詞／形容詞；instantly 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON an instant response She responded instantly.
